question:
Let
\[
a_n=\frac{n^2}{\sqrt{n^6+1}}+\frac{n^2}{\sqrt{n^6+2}}+\cdots+\frac{n^2}{\sqrt{n^6+n}},\qquad n\ge1.
\]
Then $\lim_{n\to\infty}a_n$
solution:
For $1\le r\le n$,
\[
\sqrt{n^6}\le\sqrt{n^6+r}\le\sqrt{n^6+n}.
\]
Hence
\[
1\le a_n\le\frac{n^3}{\sqrt{n^6+n}}.
\]
Both bounds tend to $1$, so by squeezing, $\lim_{n\to\infty}a_n=1$.
